services.name: Semi-Private Personal Training
services.desc: Capped at 6 people, it’s not exactly personal training and not exactly a small group class. You’ll have the perfect balance of 1-on-1, personalized workouts and coaching with with the benefits of the energy, inspiration, and comradery of committed training partners who all the same goals - willing to work hard to improve our lives. Following MovementLink’s Cross-Training blueprint, Coach Justin will be your personal coach, there to motivate, teach you technique, and customize the exercises, reps, and intensity of your workouts specifically for your fitness level and your goals, ensuring you get the optimal stimulus to generate the best possible results every session. Try it Out - Join us
